metadata.title: Retro Soul Portrait with 1970s Graphic Framing

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, warm-toned portrait of a woman with voluminous hair wearing a large wide-brimmed straw hat, featuring a distinct 1970s aesthetic with a rounded graphic badge in the upper right corner containing stylized, bubbly typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The wide brim of the hat creates a dark, curved frame around the subject's face.
The warm, amber-tinted lighting harmonizes the skin tones with the straw texture of the hat.
The graphic badge in the top right acts as a modern, structured counterpoint to the organic textures of the hair and straw.
coreInvariants: Warm, monochromatic-leaning color palette (browns, oranges, ambers)
Tight facial crop with soft-focus background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's face is centrally positioned, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame, scaled for an intimate close-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright highlight on the nose serve as the primary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the face upward to the texture of the hat, then follows the curve of the brim to the graphic badge in the top right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows under the hat brim provide significant dark negative space that emphasizes the facial features.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep umber and warm brown tones define the shadows and hair.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Golden amber and ochre provide highlights on the skin and hat texture.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright orange and white are used exclusively for the graphic badge and typography outlines.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a heavy emphasis on mid-to-dark values, creating a moody, vintage atmosphere.
paletteRestrictions: Limit palette to earth tones and warm oranges

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold, rounded display sans-serif with interlocking ligatures.
letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight kerning with overlapping characters
Heavy, bulbous terminals and rounded counters
Thick, multi-layered outlines (inline and outline effects)
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'i' with a large circular tittle that merges into adjacent letters
Swash-like extensions on capital letters that wrap around the word

composition.relationshipToImage: Contained within a rounded rectangular badge

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A secondary, smaller script or sans-serif is used for sub-headers, placed directly below the main display text.
graphicDevices: Rounded rectangular container with a thick orange border

preserve: The interlocking nature of the letters

candidateDirections.reason: Reflects the multi-line/outline aesthetic of the era

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-grain, warm-toned 1970s film portrait of a woman with an afro and a wide-brimmed straw hat. Lighting should be amber-hued, coming from the side. Leave the top right corner clear for a graphic element.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a rounded rectangular badge in the top right with an orange border. Inside, place custom interlocking bubble lettering with a white fill and thick orange/brown outlines.

verificationChecks: Is the film grain visible and consistent?
Do the letters in the badge overlap or touch?
Is the color palette strictly warm (browns/oranges)?

adjustableVariables: Saturation of the orange accent color
mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness issues
Unique lettering shapes to avoid direct font copying
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the hat texture is tactile and detailed.
Check that the typography badge does not look 'pasted on' but integrated via grain.
Verify the skin tones are rich and warm without being oversaturated.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a tight, warm-toned vintage portrait with a top-corner 'badge' containing interlocking 70s display type.
